lines: {target}? Gentle ground can make travelers careless.
Make sure travelers know this before visiting Meadow. Rest there, but do not forget night comes.
Flowers and bees do not bar the dark.
A journey to Meadow is no small story. I would keep half the quiver for the way home.
I will remember Meadow as soft grass that still needs a lantern.

{target}? Stone peaks make every fall honest.
Your best advice for Stony Peaks sounds simple. Bring blocks and stop before your legs shake.

{target}? Gravel moves when you most need it still.
I would tell anyone planning a trip to Windswept Gravelly Hills one thing. Test every slope before trusting it.
Loose stone tells lies under boots.
A journey to Windswept Gravelly Hills is no small story. That is not a place to waste the first arrow.

{target}? Hard wind turns every edge into advice.
People setting out for Windswept Hills should remember this. Keep low and do not race the mountain.
Clouds move fast up there and so can mistakes.
A journey to Windswept Hills is no small story. I would watch the ground before watching the target.
